// A triply periodic scalar field: the nodal implicit of the named family,
// repeating every Period along each axis, shifted so that its zero level set is
// the Level isosurface of the raw implicit. Level 0 is the minimal surface
// itself; moving it off zero trades one labyrinth's volume for the other's.
// Values are unitless and are NOT a distance — the solid types below carry the
// Lipschitz division that turns them into one.
type TpmsField3D
    implements IValue, IScalarField3D
{
    Family: TpmsFamily;
    Period: Number;
    Level: Number;
}
